title: Asheri Primary Health Centre
summary: A modern Primary Healthcare Centre is under construction in Asheri to bring essential medical services closer to residents.
body: A modern Primary Healthcare Centre is under construction in Asheri to bring essential medical services closer to residents.
The centre will provide primary clinical care, maternal and child healthcare, and routine health screenings for the community.

title: Ganyingbo Topa CBT and Tutorial Centre
summary: A modern Computer-Based Test (CBT) Centre and Tutorial Centre to help students prepare for JAMB, WAEC and GCE examinations.
body: A modern Computer-Based Test (CBT) Centre and Tutorial Centre to help students prepare for JAMB, WAEC and GCE examinations.
The facility provides high-speed digital examination terminals, reliable solar power, and specialized tutorial classes for secondary school candidates.

title: Inner Roads Grading and Sand-filling
summary: Grading and sand-filling of more than 50 inner roads across the five wards to ensure year-round community connectivity.
body: Grading and sand-filling of more than 50 inner roads across the five wards to improve access for residents, traders, and agricultural goods.

title: Perimeter Fencing, Methodist Primary School, Sawa
summary: A model perimeter fence and school renovation for a safer and more secure learning environment.
body: Construction of a comprehensive perimeter security fence and structural rehabilitation at Methodist Primary School, Sawa.

title: Perimeter Fencing, L.A. Primary School, Apa
summary: Perimeter fencing constructed at L.A. Primary School, Apa, safeguarding students and educational assets.
body: Erection of a perimeter security wall enclosing the school compound to protect pupils and deter unauthorized entry.

title: Solar-Powered Borehole, Akoko Community
summary: A solar-powered borehole to improve access to clean, reliable water for households and small businesses.
body: Installation of a deep industrial borehole equipped with high-efficiency solar water pumps, overhead storage tanks, and multi-point dispensing taps.
